notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creture token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
